pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. The scoring formula is (price threshold ÷ proponent's price) × weighting = proponent's pricing points. Proponents must submit a Pricing Excel Workbook and a Requirements Excel Workbook. Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes.
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a pricing formula using the rates set out in the Proponent's submitted Pricing Sheet (Attachment 2). Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: (price threshold ÷ proponent's price) × weighting = proponent's pricing points. ... Proponents should submit their pricing information by completing the attached Pricing Sheet and including it in their proposals. ... Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes.

references_required.quote: At least two and at most five references for implementations involving the proposed solutions in Canada.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Cowichan Tribes will conduct a cumulative assessment and invite the top two or three vendors to provide a demonstration at their discretion. Vendors selected for the demonstration stage will be required to present their proposed solutions in accordance with the demo script that will be provided by Cowichan Tribes.
